snippet.title: Ratocalypse Teaser (2025.12)
snippet.description:
A strategy RPG where you design the AI of your characters!
The prince of a fallen kingdom, ruined by a zombie plague, 
investigates the capital overrun with the undead in search of hope to resolve the crisis.

Steam Store: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156040/Ratocalypse/
